title: Sea Esta Villa | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Choose this Vacation Home:* Private Resort-Style Pool* Short Stroll (3.5 minutes) to the Sugar-White Sands of 30A* 6 BIKES Included* Two beach access points nearby that include public restrooms.* Walk to Brozinni Pizzeria, Café 30A, Angelina’s Italian and Dough
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Choose this Vacation Home:* Private Resort-Style Pool* Short Stroll (3.5 minutes) to the Sugar-White Sands of 30A* 6 BIKES Included* Two beach access points nearby that include public restrooms.* Walk to Brozinni Pizzeria, Café 30A, Angelina’s Italian and Dough Sea Dough* Under 2 Miles to Seaside* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service* This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.Welcome to Sea Esta Villa, your luxury coastal escape in beautiful Santa Rosa Beach along Scenic Highway 30A. This Mediterranean-inspired home blends upscale finishes with relaxed beach living, just a short walk to the Gulf. Inside, you’ll find a bright, open layout perfect for gathering, plus a chef’s kitchen featuring Viking appliances, quartz countertops, and a spacious island for easy entertaining. This home comfortably accommodates families and multi-generational groups with plenty of privacy across three levels perfect for your family vacation! Step outside to your private courtyard oasis with:• Sparkling pool• Shaded patio seating• Built-in gas grill• Outdoor dining spaceSleeping Arrangements2nd Floor• Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed• Guest Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Private Balcony Access• Guest Bedroom 3: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed with Twin Trundle3rd Floor• Master Suite: King Bed, spa-style en-suite bathroom, private balcony• Guest Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Private BalconyThe LocationLocated in the gated community of Palmeira Villas at Seagrove Beach, Sea Esta Villa offers a prime 30A setting without the heavy crowds — yet still close to everything. Positioned between Rosemary, Alys, and Seaside, relaxed beach village feel without the hustle and bustle. You’re within walking distance to local dining favorites including:• Café 30A• Angelina's Pizzeria and Pasta• Dough Sea DoughJust under 2 miles away is iconic Seaside, known for its charming architecture, boutique shopping, farmer’s market, and incredible dining options.Area HighlightsSea Turtle Reef:Snorkelers will love the nearby artificial reef deployed off Grayton Beach State Park. Located in 12–19 feet of water, this reef has become a vibrant habitat for marine life. We recommend using a kayak, paddleboard, or flotation device when visiting.The Big Chill at Prominence:About 3 miles east, The Big Chill 30A offers outdoor movies, live music, and casual dining — perfect for families.Important Information• No parties or events permitted• No rentals to adults under 25 (strictly enforced)• Professionally managed with 24/7 guest supportWhether you're biking 30A, relaxing by your private pool, dining at award-winning restaurants, or spending your days on the beach, Sea Esta Villa delivers the elevated 30A experience guests return to year after year.Book your stay and experience the best of Santa Rosa Beach.
